Fictional company handbook - teaching fixture
Page 1: travel accommodation
Shanghai: hotel reimbursement up to CNY 650 per person per night.
Beijing: up to CNY 550 per person per night.
Other cities: up to CNY 450 per person per night.
Meals and transport are separate expenses.
Amounts above the cap need prior written approval.

Page 2: reimbursement procedure
Submit within 15 working days after the trip.
Required: hotel invoice, travel approval and expense details.
Manager reviews the trip; finance checks invoices and limits.
Shanghai office meeting meals: CNY 80 per person.
This meeting budget is not the hotel reimbursement cap.

notes: 复用生产 DocumentParser；PDF 保留物理页码，Word 保留章节与表格顺序，不虚构 Word 页码。
PDF 示例为英文文本；Word 和 Markdown 示例为中文。扫描 PDF 需要 OCR，当前不支持。
